hypotheses.persona: Standard working adult with a dog
hypotheses.rationale: Consistent morning coffee (07:53), evening leash retrieval (17:12), and midday meal (11:55) strongly suggest a standard work schedule with a lunch break or flexible hours. The dog items (leash, ball, chew toy) confirm pet ownership. No evidence contradicts this.

Still possible if the resident works from an unobserved room or uses a co-working space. The midday plate could indicate a WFH lunch. However, the lack of work devices (laptop, documents) across 11 days makes this highly unlikely.
Contradicted by consistent early morning (07:32-07:53) and late afternoon (17:12) activity patterns aligned with standard circadian rhythms.

The midday chew toy at the mudroom suggests the dog was active during the day, possibly with the resident. Need to observe Day 12-13 (weekend) for any changes in routine or appearance of weekend-specific items (e.g., suitcase, sports gear, different meal patterns).
